verdict.rationale: Veriff offers a dedicated PEP & Sanctions add-on check priced alongside identity verification, a watchlist-screening webhook that returns PEP, sanctions, adverse-media, and ongoing-monitoring results, and a unified Customer Portal for manual review of sessions — all within the same API/vendor pipeline used for identity verification. This confirms one-vendor, one-API, one-review-surface screening as part of the same flow. Missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation of watchlist accuracy or coverage, and explicit documentation on how PEP/sanctions results integrate into the same decision object as identity verification (vs. separate webhook).
